title: Warp: Structured Output-Space Adaptation for Frozen Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2606.31043v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Robot policies that remain broadly competent after deployment can degrade when dynamics, contact, geometry, actuation, or sensing differ from source conditions. We study post-hoc adaptation through structured output-space adapters: compact transformations of samples from a frozen base policy. We introduce Warp, a context-conditioned monotone bijective spline that enables nonlinear sample-dependent reshaping while preserving per-dimension ordering; Translation and Affine provide location-only and location--scale references. Across four ManiSkill tasks with controlled deployment shifts, Warp achieves the strongest recovery in a matched evolution-strategy (ES) adapter study, outperforming controls for spline parameterization, location--scale adaptation, and generic nonlinear capacity. Under PPO, the ordering becomes task dependent, showing that richer adapter structure does not automatically translate into better adaptation under a diff

translated_title: Warp：面向冻结机器人策略的结构化输出空间自适应
translated_abstract: 部署后仍保持广泛能力的机器人策略，当动力学、接触、几何、执行或传感条件与源条件不同时可能出现性能退化。我们研究了通过结构化输出空间适配器进行的事后自适应方法，即对冻结基础策略的输出样本进行紧凑变换。我们提出了Warp，一种上下文条件化的单调双射样条，它能够在保持每个维度排序的同时，实现非线性的、依赖样本的重新塑形；平移和仿射变换则分别作为仅位置和位置-尺度的参照基准。在四个具有受控部署偏移的ManiSkill任务上，在一项匹配条件的进化策略（ES）适配器研究中，Warp实现了最强的性能恢复，优于样条参数化、位置-尺度自适应以及通用非线性容量的对照方法。而在PPO下，各方法的排序变得依赖于具体任务，这表明更丰富的适配器结构并不一定自动转化为更好的自适应效果……
tldr: 提出了Warp，一种上下文条件化的单调双射样条适配器，能在不修改冻结机器人策略的前提下对其输出进行保序的非线性重整形，从而在受控部署偏移的ManiSkill任务中实现最强的性能恢复。
en_tdlr: Warp is a context-conditioned monotone bijective spline adapter that non-linearly reshapes the outputs of frozen robot policies while preserving per-dimension ordering, achieving the strongest recovery across controlled deployment shifts in ManiSkill tasks.
